acchodaka.p: [Accha+udaka] (ti) CL=10 Acchodakā, acchodikā In thī] To have clear water

CPD: acchôdaka , mfn. ( accha + udaka), with clear water; in the formula: ~, sātḍdaka, sītḍdaka, setaka, sūpatittha, ramaṇīya: MN l 76, 27 (pokkharanī) — 283, 36 = SN l 91, 6 = AN lll 190, 5 (Mp); 238, 11 ; DN ll 128, 28 (Kakutthā nadī ~ikā [ not ~akã] = pasannḍdakā, Sv); — Vin lll 108, 15 (daho ~o, etc. — pasannḍdako, Sp), quoted Ps lll 645, 15 ; — f . ~ā Vv 901 (pokkharaṇī); f. pl. ~ā (pokkharañño), Vv 482. ( Rem.: Kakutthaṃ acchôdi -sãtôdika-vippa- sannaṃ, DN ll 135, 4 *, haplology as in somana- domanassaṃ, Sn 67, see Sadd lll 158).
